question: A charged particle moves perpendicular to a uniform magnetic field. If its kinetic energy is made four times without changing the magnetic field, how will the radius of its circular path change? Justify your answer.

options.A: The radius becomes four times, $r'=4r$, because $r\propto K$.
options.B: Since $r\propto v$ and $K=\dfrac12mv^2$, $r\propto\sqrt K$. Therefore, when $K'=4K$, $r'=\sqrt4\,r=2r$.
options.C: The radius remains unchanged because the magnetic field is unchanged.
options.D: The radius becomes half, $r'=\dfrac r2$, because speed doubles.
